Prior teams treated model selection as an information-retrieval and routing
problem, using query evidence, response evidence, learned rankers, and hybrid
signals. The controlling review preserves the paper-level citations.

## Why this matters for 2026

It identifies credible approach families and helps distinguish a genuine gap
from a renamed prior method.

## What this does not prove

Prior-track results do not establish effectiveness on this development data or
the unavailable hidden test. See
[`reports/trec_2025_mllm_literature_review.md`](../../../reports/trec_2025_mllm_literature_review.md).
